root_cause_criterion.missing_conjunct: when `curr->flavor == CIL_OPTIONAL`, `cil_print_recursive_blockinherit` must not evaluate `NODE(((struct cil_blockinherit *)curr->data)->block)` and must instead record the optional ancestor directly
root_cause_criterion.criterion: At the recursive-blockinherit trace site, an optional ancestor is only safe if it is recorded through the optional/other branch rather than through the vulnerable blockinherit-only `NODE(((struct cil_blockinherit *)curr->data)->block)` source.
root_cause_criterion.description: The ASan root cause is the missing flavor guard at `cil_print_recursive_blockinherit`: the vulnerable original reaches the optional ancestor and still uses the blockinherit-only node source, while the fixed original records the same optional ancestor without evaluating that expression.

nodes.state: At the optional ancestor, the vulnerable cast reads `((struct cil_blockinherit *)curr->data)->block` from a `struct cil_optional`, so the extracted pointer equals `DATUM(curr->data)->name`.
The subsequent `NODE(...)` dereference uses that same carried pointer as its datum argument, which is the source-level sink reported by ASan.

edges.relation: The misread pointer extracted from the optional node is passed unchanged into `NODE(...)` as the datum whose `nodes->head->data` field is dereferenced.
